title: 安田記念の後に・強く鋭く

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Yamanin Zephyr wins the Yasuda Kinen in spectacular fashion. She's successfully taken her first step towards her goal of conquering three distances.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: But she can't rest on her laurels. With this first win behind her, it's now time to focus on our chosen sprint race—the Sprinters Stakes.
